project: CYCS 3240 Secure Embedded Water Tank Controller
author: Finley Burns
goal_engine: One active goal at a time; activate queued goals in deadline order.
shared_requirements: Direct first-person prose, plain headings, concrete explanations and minimal filler
Separate completed results from planned or unverified features
Keep November 12 submission independent and ready to submit
Portable Windows, macOS and Linux host workflow; document actual platform verification
Read test data from files and preserve raw evidence
Do not include private conversation or handoff attachments in course submissions
Native x86-64 and ARM64 host build routes; Cortex-M4 ARM firmware; record actual architecture and execution status
Synchronize source, submissions and evidence to GitHub without private handoff or chat

goals.objective: Deliver the testing design PDF and organized supporting files.
goals.acceptance: All test problems, methods, parameters, expectations and reasons included; prose reviewed; seven pages visually checked; ZIP and hashes verified.

goals.deadline_source: User confirmed November 17 as presentation date.
goals.objective: Deliver an editable design presentation and speaking notes.
goals.acceptance: Explain scope, approach, control decisions, interfaces, security design, tests and current progress; accurate status; readable slides; inspect every rendered slide.

goals.objective: Deliver the comprehensive design PDF with detailed pseudocode, module descriptions, interfaces, dependencies and error behavior.
goals.acceptance: Enough detail to implement the system; consistent with testing design; code versus planned modules clearly distinguished; prose and all rendered pages reviewed.

goals.objective: Finish the implementation and testing, then deliver the comprehensive final IEEE-format report, source, results and user guide.
goals.acceptance: Actual results for remaining modules and goals analysis; accurate limitations; authentic IEEE template; complete reproducible source and user guide; no unfinished feature described as tested. Draft alone does not complete this goal.
goals.verification: Four IEEE pages visually reviewed; 18 native tank runs, 1815 ARM sensor/serial checks and 6001 ARM feedback samples passed; six native OS/architecture CI jobs passed; fresh extraction host tests and ARM build passed.

goals.objective: Deliver final presentation slides and speaking notes based on the completed project and actual results.
goals.acceptance: Explain implementation, measured behavior, examples, goal completion and limits; match final report; inspect every rendered slide. Draft alone does not complete this goal.
goals.verification: Twelve editable slides and notes; every rendered slide reviewed; package, geometry, font and import checks passed.
